messages.subject: update reactiveValues from file
parts:
Okay, I'm making a little personal reading list in shiny.

You enter an amazon url and a comment, hit submit and it shows the book cover on the main panel (more functionality to be added later)

Then, it saves these to a file so next time I start it up, the books I've previously entered are there.

The problem is, my re-loading of the old books doesn't happen until I start typing in the textInput boxes. Is there any way to make it happen when the website loads first...

Here's a gist with the code... runGist("https://gist.github.com/corynissen/340d13bcaa55de070b35")

And an example amazon book url... http://www.amazon.com/Cities-Small-Planet-Icon-Editions/dp/0813335531/ref=pd_sim_b_1?ie=UTF8&refRID=0M6NNM57ERWAG8ZJ3Z19

Thanks

Cory
